_comment: Hawthorne analyzer configuration. Rules are warnings by default. Use SuppressMessageAttribute with a non-blank Justification for intentional source-level suppressions.

rules._comment: Each rule can set enabled and severity. Metric rules also define their maximum thresholds.

HAW001._comment: Reports interfaces with exactly one concrete implementation in this compilation. Disabled here for this sample.

HAW002._comment: Reports factories that always construct one fixed type without meaningful selection, configuration, or lifecycle behavior.

HAW003._comment: Reports pass-through methods and types whose members mostly forward calls without adding behavior.

HAW004._comment: Reports static shared instances that expose mutable state. requireMutableState controls whether mutable state is required.

HAW101._comment: Reports methods whose cyclomatic complexity exceeds maximum.

HAW102._comment: Reports methods whose cognitive complexity exceeds maximum.

HAW103._comment: Reports methods whose control-flow nesting depth exceeds maximum.

HAW104._comment: Reports types that depend on more distinct external types than maximum.

HAW105._comment: Reports methods longer than either configured executable-statement or physical-line limit.

HAW900._comment: Reports invalid hawthorne.json content as a compiler error. This diagnostic is always an error when configuration is invalid.

HAW901._comment: Reports Hawthorne pragma suppression and SuppressMessageAttribute entries whose Justification is missing or blank.
